whatIs: The Prompts Factory is a library of prompts for websites, animations and transitions. Each one includes an interactive preview of the effect and the implementation instructions: layout, motion, interactions and responsive behavior.
It's a good fit when you want to reproduce a specific effect with an AI coding tool instead of describing it from scratch.
uses: Adding an animated page transition to a project by asking your coding assistant to implement the prompt.
Exploring scroll effects or animations in the preview before deciding which one to adopt.
Bookmarking several effects to reuse across different projects.
caveats: You can view the previews without an account, but you have to sign in to copy prompts, and the free plan allows 5 copies per month.
Results vary depending on the AI tool and the context; test the motion on mobile, with a keyboard and with reduced motion before you publish.
The license lets you adapt the prompts in personal and client projects, but not redistribute or resell them.
pricingNote: Free with 5 copies per month; the first paid plan, Basic, costs $9.99 per month for 30 copies.
idealFor: Developers who want specific effects and animations ready to hand to an AI.
